items.question: How do you qualify affiliate traffic?
items.answer: We combine funnel telemetry, payment integrity checks, and cohort retention benchmarks before scaling budgets.

items.question: Which markets do you prioritize?
items.answer: Tiered coverage across EU regulated clusters with selective tier-2 expansion depending on brand readiness.

items.question: How are payouts structured?
items.answer: Hybrid schedules are reconciled monthly with finance-grade statements and dispute SLAs.

items.answer: Yes — localized reviews with turnaround targets during seasonal pushes.
